issues.description: The SQL result shape for Aufgabe 02 is inconsistent between the problem specification and the solution file. The problem statement (problem_statement.md line 23) requires exactly three columns: the Freizeitpark name, the Freizeitpark street, and the name of the associated Gemeinde. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql line 1) selects an additional column Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel, which returns more data than requested and violates the instruction "Gib immer genau die geforderten Daten aus und nicht mehr." This extra column will cause a mismatch with automated checks that expect exactly the three specified columns and therefore confuses students about the correct output shape.
issues.suggestedFix: Edit solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql so the SELECT list contains only the requested columns. Replace the current SELECT line with: SELECT Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, Gemeinde.name FROM Freizeitpark, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel. Remove Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel from the SELECT list so the query returns exactly the three columns required by the problem statement.
